statusDetail: Coverage complete across 58 atomic checks and six representative paths. No local source was provided; critique only.

page.framework: Server-rendered PHP/W3.CSS-style pages with third-party advertising SDKs
page.notes: Public adult-video listing/detail site. Representative coverage includes home, category, tag listing, search, video detail, and 404. Pagination duplicates listing templates and was not separately audited; outbound advertisers and the external stories site were excluded as separate origins.

paths.description: Homepage and primary discovery surface; selected as the entry page and representative video listing.
Category index archetype, representing taxonomy navigation.
HD tag listing, representing filtered/listing templates.
Video detail and download/play journey, the site primary content flow.
Search-results journey exercised with a representative query.
Invalid URL used to inspect HTTP failure and recovery.

findings.summary: The site ignores the user’s dark theme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot remains the same hard-coded light grey/white palette as the default capture; DOM reports color-scheme: normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven light/dark surface and text colors.

findings.summary: Cross-page navigation swaps abruptly without View Transitions.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS probe found no view-transition rules on a multi-page site.
findings.suggestedFix: Use @view-transition { navigation: auto } for same-origin MPA navigation, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Very long listings provide no position-aware navigation or progress affordance.
findings.evidence: Mobile home and tag layouts are 10,478px and 9,374px tall, while CSS/DOM show no sticky scroll-state navigation or progress indicator.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrained sticky header or progress/back-to-top affordance that responds to scroll state.

findings.summary: Third-party ads obscure primary content on load.
findings.evidence: Desktop and mobile screenshots show large ad video blocks plus a fixed bottom overlay covering page content, with only a small close target.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove load-time interstitial/sticky ads; reserve non-obscuring ad slots and require user initiation for media.

findings.summary: Overlays use ad-hoc divs instead of semantic, accessible primitives.
findings.evidence: DOM probe found custom .w3-overlay and injected fixed div/video wrappers; there are no dialog or popover elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Use dialog/popover for authored overlays with focus management, Escape/light dismiss, and named close buttons.

findings.summary: Reusable cards and navigation adapt only through viewport breakpoints.
findings.evidence: CSS probe found no @container/container-type even though card and navigation components are reused across home, tag, search, and category layouts.
findings.suggestedFix: Make reusable cards container-query components and keep viewport queries only for page-level composition.

findings.summary: Many controls and links have undersized targets.
findings.evidence: The interaction probe found numerous visible anchors only 16–17px high; Lighthouse also reports accessibility failures, despite a visible browser-default focus outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide at least 24px minimum targets, preferably 44px for primary mobile controls, without removing focus-visible outlines.

findings.summary: Ads dominate and interrupt the primary browse-to-video flow.
findings.evidence: The video-detail mobile screenshot places unrelated ad cards before the player, while a fixed ad covers the lower viewport; the home screenshot likewise places ads before the listing.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep browse, play, and download actions in a clear uninterrupted path; move ads out of the primary flow and eliminate overlays/popunders.

findings.summary: The 404 state is a dead end.
findings.evidence: A real HTTP 404 returns a nearly blank nginx page with only “404 Not Found” and no home, search, or retry route.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a branded 404 with a plain explanation, home/search links, and preserved navigation.
findings.guidanceId: loading empty error success retry undo cancel state

findings.summary: The fast first paint hides a wasteful 3.04MB load with weak caching.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 82 requests and 3,041,226 transferred bytes; Lighthouse estimates 463KiB cache savings. Confirmed scripts are async/defer, so parser candidates were not treated as render blockers.
findings.suggestedFix: Cache static assets, stop eager ad media fetches, and keep non-critical third-party resources deferred until consent/interaction.

findings.summary: Third-party code dominates requests and avoidable JavaScript is shipped.
findings.evidence: HAR attributes 43 requests and 2,339,486 bytes to third parties; Lighthouse estimates 32KiB unused JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove low-value ad SDKs, deduplicate integrations, and conditionally load retained third parties.

findings.summary: A large set of interactive links and ad media lacks accessible names.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails link-name and frame-title; the active probe found repeated unnamed image links and unnamed videos.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every actionable link/control a meaningful accessible name, title third-party frames, and hide purely decorative ad media from the accessibility tree.

findings.summary: Text and essential UI fail WCAG contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse color-contrast audit scored 0 and identified low-contrast content; the default screenshot shows pale breadcrumb/footer text on light backgrounds.
findings.suggestedFix: Use tested foreground/background tokens meeting WCAG AA and verify all states.

findings.summary: Pages have no main landmark.
findings.evidence: The active probe reports mainCount: 0 and Lighthouse fails landmark-one-main. Browser-default focus is visible, but the landmark structure is incomplete.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap primary page content in one <main> and preserve a logical heading/focus sequence.

findings.summary: Dense, clipped small text reduces reading comfort.
findings.evidence: DOM shows 12–15px card/ad text, fixed 21px heights, nowrap/clamping, and overflow:hidden; mobile screenshots show crowded labels and truncated content.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase text size/line height and remove fixed-height clipping from meaningful labels.

findings.summary: Media and small targets do not offer an inclusive equivalent.
findings.evidence: The video detail has an autoplaying primary video with no caption/subtitle tracks; many links are only 16–17px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Add captions/transcripts for meaningful video and enlarge targets while preserving reflow and scaling.

findings.summary: Images are unsized, oversized, and delivered with poor responsive hygiene.
findings.evidence: Images primitive found 32/32 missing complete dimensions, 31 without srcset, 15 oversized, and 32 legacy-format images; Lighthouse also fails image aspect/size audits.
findings.suggestedFix: Set width and height, preserve aspect ratio, provide srcset/sizes, and encode suitable images as WebP/AVIF.

findings.summary: Browser inspector issues remain unresolved.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse best-practices score is 0.69 and inspector-issues scores 0, although console errors, doctype, and charset checks pass.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve the concrete DevTools inspector issues and retest without suppressing browser warnings.

findings.summary: Public pages omit canonical URLs.
findings.evidence: Home and video probes found no rel=canonical, even though robots permits indexing and sitemap.xml is valid.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit a self-referencing canonical on each indexable canonical URL and keep sitemap entries consistent.

findings.summary: Video entities lack structured data and the homepage lacks social metadata.
findings.evidence: The video has basic Open Graph tags but no JSON-LD VideoObject; the homepage has neither Open Graph nor JSON-LD.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate VideoObject JSON-LD to details and Open Graph/Twitter metadata to shareable pages.

findings.summary: Security headers and cookie protections are substantially incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers probe found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy. Cookie probe found two cookies without Secure, all four SameSite=None, and one 400-day cookie.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy; minimize cookies and set Secure/SameSite deliberately.

findings.summary: The page initiates a large tracking/advertising footprint before user choice.
findings.evidence: Trackers/HAR observed 12 third-party origins, 43 third-party requests, 2.34MB third-party transfer, cookie-sync endpoints, and no consent surface before loading.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unnecessary partners and gate non-essential advertising/tracking behind informed consent; batch/minimize retained analytics.

findings.summary: Global/multilingual content is paired with physically-directed CSS.
findings.evidence: The site declares lang=en, but authored CSS uses repeated left/right properties and has no dir declaration, making bidi/translation layouts brittle.
findings.suggestedFix: Use logical inline/block properties, set dir appropriately, and expose language changes for non-English content.

findings.summary: Ad and popunder mechanics create deceptive, coercive navigation risk.
findings.evidence: The page loads multiple ad SDKs including puengine/popunder code, presents unrelated ads before primary content, and overlays a tiny close button over content.
findings.suggestedFix: Eliminate popunders and disguised/forced ad interactions; clearly label ads and make dismissal and return to content straightforward.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bytes and lacks modern responsive formats.
findings.evidence: All 32 scanned images are JPEG/legacy, 31 lack responsive sources, 15 exceed twice their displayed width, and below-fold images are not lazy loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate right-sized AVIF/WebP variants, use srcset/sizes, dimensions, and lazy-load below-fold images.

findings.summary: Background ad work fetches media before it provides user value.
findings.evidence: HAR shows about 1.87MB XHR-fetch and 269KB media, dominated by ad MP4s; the detail page sets the primary video autoplay=true and preload=auto.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not autoplay or preload non-essential media; defer advertising/media until visible or explicitly requested.

findings.summary: Third-party media is disproportionate to the site’s core content.
findings.evidence: Third parties account for 77% of 3.04MB transferred on the homepage, including eager ad videos; fixed ad media also obscures content.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party/media budget, remove low-value vendors, and load retained media only after interaction with useful caching.

taskList.title: Remove obstructive/popunder advertising and defer all ad media
Add semantic structure, accessible names, contrast, captions and target sizing
Deploy security headers and harden/minimize cookies
Optimize responsive images and resource delivery
Add robust 404 recovery and uninterrupted core flow
Replace physical CSS with logical properties
